A trade license can be bought from the [[royal services|royal services box]] for {{money|5000}}. You must purchase the rightful citizen status for another {{money|300}} in advance.

Without these papers, you won't be able to open a [[trade office]] to sell {{item|crate}}s in the [[town]] with  the [[merchant]] as your business partner.
